description: Census Bureau TIGER/Line 2026 shapefile zips as downloaded by `_shared/scripts/download_raw.sh tiger` from the URLs in `scripts/urls.txt`: state, county, tract, bg, place, zcta520, aiannh, uac20, cbsa, primaryroads, prisecroads, rails. National layers are one zip (`tl_2026_us_<layer>.zip`); tract, bg, place and prisecroads are one zip per state or territory (`tl_2026_<FIPS>_<layer>.zip`). Geometries are EPSG:4269 (NAD83). Boundaries are as of January 1, 2026. Read-only.
